PMF.totalVariation: For probability laws p and q on the same finite alphabet A, their total variation distance is TV(p,q) = ½ ∑ₐ∈A |p(a) − q(a)|.
PMF.totalVariation_nonneg: For any two probability laws p and q on the same finite alphabet, their total variation distance is nonnegative.
PMF.totalVariation_le_one: For any two probability laws p and q on the same finite alphabet, their total variation distance is at most one.
PMF.totalVariation_self: Every probability law on a finite alphabet has total variation distance zero from itself.
PMF.totalVariation_comm: Total variation is symmetric. For any two finite laws p and q, TV(p,q) = TV(q,p).
PMF.totalVariation_eq_zero_iff: Two laws on the same finite alphabet have total variation distance zero if and only if they assign the same mass to every outcome.
PMF.totalVariation_triangle: For three laws on the same finite alphabet, TV(p,r) ≤ TV(p,q) + TV(q,r).
PMF.toOuterMeasure_toReal_eq_sum: On a finite alphabet, the real probability of an event S is the sum of the masses p(a) over all a in S.
PMF.totalVariation_eq_sum_pos: The total variation distance equals the sum of the excess masses p(a) − q(a) over the outcomes for which p(a) ≥ q(a).
PMF.abs_toOuterMeasure_sub_le_totalVaria: For any event S on a finite alphabet, |p(S) − q(S)| ≤ TV(p,q).
PMF.totalVariation_eq_toOuterMeasure_sub: Let S consist of all outcomes a with p(a) ≥ q(a). On this event, p(S) − q(S) equals TV(p,q).
PMF.totalVariation_isGreatest_event: Among all events S on the finite alphabet, the largest value of p(S) − q(S) is TV(p,q).
PMF.totalVariation_isGreatest_abs_event: Among all events S on the finite alphabet, the largest absolute difference |p(S) − q(S)| is TV(p,q).
PMF.totalVariation_eq_sum_sub_min: Remove the common mass min(p(a),q(a)) from p(a) at each outcome. The sum of the masses left over equals TV(p,q).
PMF.totalVariation_eq_one_sub_sum_min: The total variation distance equals one minus the overlap mass, TV(p,q) = 1 − ∑ₐ min(p(a),q(a)).
PMF.sum_min_eq_ofReal_one_sub_totalVaria: In extended nonnegative arithmetic, the overlap ∑ₐ min(p(a),q(a)) equals the real number 1 − TV(p,q) embedded in that number system.
PMF.ofReal_totalVariation_eq_sum_sub: Viewed as an extended nonnegative number, TV(p,q) equals ∑ₐ max(p(a) − q(a),0), the total of all positive excess masses.
PMF.totalVariation_eq_one_iff_disjoint_s: Two laws on the same finite alphabet have total variation distance one exactly when their supports are disjoint.
PMF.abs_sum_sub_le_totalVariation_of_mem: If ℓ ≤ u and ℓ ≤ f(a) ≤ u at every outcome, the absolute difference between the means of f under p and q is at most (u − ℓ) TV(p,q).
PMF.abs_sum_sub_le_mul_totalVariation: If |f(a)| ≤ M everywhere and M ≥ 0, the absolute difference between the means of f under p and q is at most 2M TV(p,q).
PMF.totalVariation_isGreatest_unitInterv: Over all functions f from the finite alphabet into [0,1], the maximum absolute difference between the means of f under p and q equals TV(p,q).
PMF.two_mul_totalVariation_isGreatest_bo: Over all real functions f on the finite alphabet with |f(a)| ≤ 1 everywhere, the maximum absolute difference between the means of f under p and q equals 2 TV(p,q).
PMF.totalVariation_bind_le: Passing p and q through the same channel between finite alphabets gives output laws at total variation distance at most TV(p,q).
PMF.totalVariation_map_le: Let p and q be laws on the same finite alphabet A, and let f map A into a finite alphabet B. Applying f to both laws cannot increase their total variation distance.
PMF.totalVariation_map_equiv: Bijectively relabeling the outcomes of two finite laws preserves their total variation distance.
